tasks.title: Add Copy card link button to task details modal
tasks.description: Single task covering the whole requirement WEB-101; the Tech Lead owns design decision, delegation to the developer and review.
tasks.brief: Users want to share a Kanban card in one click. In the task details modal (the Jira-style dialog opened from a card), add a 'Copy card link' button that copies the card's markdown URL, http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/<KEY>?format=md, to the clipboard. This is the same URL agents use to read their card, so it lets someone hand a card to an agent or teammate without typing. Scope is a small UI change only; no server changes are expected because GET /api/tasks/:key?format=md already exists. Please plan the change, delegate the implementation to web-dev on its own card, review it, and report the result here. Open questions you can decide yourself: exact placement (the modal header next to the key badge/close button looks natural), and whether to build the URL from window.location.origin or keep the fixed localhost:3000 base the user asked for. Record that decision on the thread.
acceptanceCriteria: The task details modal shows a clearly labelled 'Copy card link' button for every card
Clicking it copies exactly http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/<KEY>?format=md where <KEY> is the open card's key (cleaned the same way the badge shows it, URL-encoded)
The button shows a short 'Copied' confirmation, consistent with the existing Copy Logs button
Clicking the button does not close the modal or open another card
Build (npm run build / tsc) passes and the existing look of the modal is preserved

decisions: Modal header is around line 629 of KanbanBoard.tsx (key badge rendered with sanitizeTaskKey)
Reuse the pattern of handleCopyLogs (navigator.clipboard.writeText + copied state with 2s timeout, e.stopPropagation)
Endpoint GET /api/tasks/:key?format=md already exists on the server

Not verified: clicking the button and pasting the link in a browser under npm run dev. Please do that one check by hand before closing WEB-101.

Placement: modal header, right-side group immediately left of the close (X) button, as a small labelled button (Link icon + "Copy card link"). URL base: keep the fixed http://localhost:3000 base. Reason: in dev the UI runs on the Vite port (proxying /api to :3000), so window.location.origin would produce a :5173 URL that agents and curl outside the browser cannot rely on; the :3000 URL is exactly what agents are told to read. Separate copiedLinkId state so it does not interfere with Copy Logs.

tasks.title: Implement Copy card link button in KanbanBoard task modal header
tasks.description: Implements parent WEB-102 (requirement WEB-101): one-click sharing of a card's agent-readable URL from the task modal. Design decisions are recorded on WEB-102's thread.
tasks.brief: In src/components/KanbanBoard.tsx add a 'Copy card link' button to the task details modal header (around line 630-650). Contract: (1) Add a module-level constant `const CARD_LINK_BASE = 'http://localhost:3000';` and a helper `buildCardLink(task: KanbanTask) => `${CARD_LINK_BASE}/api/tasks/${encodeURIComponent(sanitizeTaskKey(task.key) || task.id)}?format=md``. (2) Add state `const [copiedLinkId, setCopiedLinkId] = useState<string | null>(null);` next to copiedLogId; do not reuse copiedLogId. (3) Add `handleCopyCardLink(task, e: React.MouseEvent)` mirroring handleCopyLogs: e.stopPropagation(); navigator.clipboard.writeText(buildCardLink(task)) and only set copied state when the promise resolves (catch and console.warn on failure so nothing throws); setCopiedLinkId(task.id); setTimeout(() => setCopiedLinkId(null), 2000). (4) Markup: wrap the existing close button in a right-side `<div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">` and put the new `<button type="button">` before the X button. Content: lucide `Link2` icon (add to the existing lucide-react import) or `Check` (emerald-600) when copied, plus label text 'Copy card link' / 'Copied'. Style it like the Copy Logs button (text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 hover:text-brand-800, flex items-center gap-1) with a light pill (px-2 py-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-sand-200/70) so it sits well next to the X; add title and aria-label 'Copy card link'. Hide the text label below sm (`hidden sm:inline`) only if it causes overflow; the icon must stay. Do not change any other part of the modal. Edge cases: card with empty/decorated key (e.g. '**WEB-5**') must yield WEB-5; clicking must not close the modal (the header is inside the stopPropagation container, but still call e.stopPropagation()); switching to another card via TaskCardDetails must not show a stale 'Copied' (keyed by task.id handles it). Verify: npm run build (tsc + vite) passes; in npm run dev open a card, click the button, paste and confirm exactly http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/<KEY>?format=md, and curl that URL returns the card markdown.
acceptanceCriteria: Task modal header shows a labelled 'Copy card link' button (icon + text, aria-label) left of the close button for every card
Clicking copies exactly http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/<KEY>?format=md, KEY = sanitizeTaskKey(task.key) URL-encoded, falling back to task.id when empty
Button shows Check icon and 'Copied' for 2s via its own copiedLinkId state; Copy Logs behaviour unchanged
Clicking does not close the modal or open another card; clipboard failure does not throw
npm run build passes; no other visual change to the modal

decisions: Fixed base http://localhost:3000 via CARD_LINK_BASE constant, not window.location.origin (Vite dev port differs)
Placement: header right group, before the X button
Mirror handleCopyLogs (line ~214) pattern with separate state

tasks.result:
Changed only src/components/KanbanBoard.tsx.
- Imported Link2 from lucide-react. Added module-level CARD_LINK_BASE = 'http://localhost:3000' and buildCardLink(task). sanitizeTaskKey moved from inside the component to module scope so buildCardLink can use it. It is a pure function and its behaviour is unchanged.
- Added copiedLinkId state, kept separate from copiedLogId, plus handleCopyCardLink(task, e). The handler calls e.stopPropagation(), then writes to the clipboard. The 'Copied' state is set only after the write succeeds and resets after 2s. Failure, or a missing clipboard API, only logs console.warn.
- Modal header: the close button now sits inside a right-side div (flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0) and the new button comes before it. The new button shows a Link2 icon, or an emerald Check once copied, with the label 'Copy card link' or 'Copied'. It has title and aria-label 'Copy card link'. Its classes are text-xs font-bold text-brand-600 hover:text-brand-800 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-sand-200/70. The label is hidden below sm so the header does not overflow on narrow screens, and the icon always shows.
Acceptance criteria:
1) Labelled button left of the X on every card: met.
2) URL format: checked buildCardLink with node. '**WEB-5**' gives http://localhost:3000/api/tasks/WEB-5?format=md, an empty key falls back to task.id, and curl on the WEB-103 link returns the card markdown.
3) Separate 2s Copied state; Copy Logs code is unchanged.
4) The click stops propagation and sits inside the modal's stopPropagation container, and clipboard failure is caught.
5) npm run build (vite) passes and tsc --noEmit reports no KanbanBoard errors. No other markup changed.
Not checked: I did not click the button and paste the link in a browser under npm run dev. Reviewer, please confirm that by hand.
